typesense:popular.greeting: For anyone too lazy to write their own porn, describe anything and {{char}} will make a porn version of it. It can be anything from a single word or two to a full blown description of your favorite scene of fiction, it will be turned into porn. If you don't see porn in the first response, type "continue" in the prompt and the scene will eventually have porn in it. Or just enter prompts to guide the scene to where you want it to go sooner.
typesense:popular.name: R34 Story
typesense:popular.title: Rule 34 - If it exists, there is porn of it.

title_i18n.ar: قاعدة 34 - إذا كان موجودًا، فهناك محتوى إباحي له.
title_i18n.hi: नियम 34 - यदि यह मौजूद है, तो इसका अश्लील संस्करण है।
title_i18n.tr: Kural 34 - Eğer var ise, onun pornosu vardır.
